verdict.rationale: Unit has a Webhook Events page (title only), configurable card controls with real-time authorization, and 'flows to automate lending and repayments'. Together these suggest event-driven hooks the customer wires up in their own code, not a native rules engine where users define triggers and actions. missing for 10: a documented rule/automation builder for event-triggered actions, details of the webhook event catalog and payloads, any no-code or declarative trigger configuration, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
